description: Cisco designs and sells a broad range of technologies including hardware, software and artificial intelligence powered digital infrastructure to power, help secure and draw insights from the Internet. It is incorporating AI into its product portfolios across networking, security, collaboration and observability and integrating its products more tightly together into a platform, simplifying how its technology is delivered, managed and optimized and helping customers maximize the business value of their technology investments. It conducts its business globally and manages its business by geography through three geographic segments, Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific, Japan and China, with its products and technologies grouped into Networking, Security, Collaboration and Observability, plus a broad range of services over the product lifecycle including technical support and professional services.
